story.iWant: to see my multi-track timeline rendered correctly in preview
story.soThat: I can verify my picture-in-picture and overlay effects
story.tasks: - Task 1: Create VideoCanvas component for multi-track rendering - Task 2: Implement PiP positioning logic - Task 3: Integrate VideoCanvas with PreviewPlayer - Task 4: Implement synchronized playback for both tracks - Task 5: Implement audio mixing - Task 6: Implement scrubbing with multi-track preview - Task 7: Optimize canvas rendering for 30fps performance - Task 8: Handle timeline clip changes during playback - Task 9: Add fallback for single-track playback - Task 10: Handle edge cases and error scenarios - Task 11: Add visual feedback for compositing - Task 12: VideoCanvas API documentation - Task 13: NFR Validation with timing requirements - Task 14: Testing and validation

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Preview player renders Track 2 clips overlaid on Track 1 clips 2. Webcam/PiP clips display in appropriate corner with correct size 3. Real-time playback shows composited multi-track result 4. Audio from both tracks mixed appropriately (Track 1 primary, Track 2 secondary) 5. Scrubbing updates preview with correct multi-track composition 6. Preview maintains 30fps smooth playback with 2 tracks

docs.doc: Exact interface from tech spec lines 292-300: track1Video/track2Video (HTMLVideoElement), pipPosition, pipSize (number), width, height. compositeFrame method draws Track 1 full-size, Track 2 as overlay with positioning.
requestAnimationFrame loop at 30fps: draw Track 1 full canvas, draw Track 2 overlay (25% size bottom-right), sync both video currentTime to playhead. NFR: loop executes within 16ms.
CORRECTED: Track 1 gain = 1.0 (100%), Track 2 gain = 0.8 (80%) per tech spec line 709 NOT 50%.

artifact.reason: Must detect multi-track timeline and switch to VideoCanvas for rendering.

story-context.constraints: - VideoCanvasProps interface matches tech spec exactly (lines 292-300) - pipSize type: number (percentage) per tech spec line 199 - requestAnimationFrame loop must execute within 16ms (tech spec line 456) - Audio mixing: Track 1 = 100%, Track 2 = 80% (CORRECTED from 50%) - Both videos currentTime sync to playhead position (tech spec line 411) - 30fps minimum playback performance (NFR003) - Single-track fallback to Video.js for better performance - Canvas context: {alpha: false} for optimization - PiP padding: 20px from canvas edges

tests.standards: Jest for unit tests. Manual integration testing for canvas compositing, audio mixing, playback sync. Performance monitoring: frame render time < 16ms, CPU usage < 70%.
tests.locations: src/renderer/src/components/Preview/__tests__/ Manual testing: multi-track preview, all PiP positions, audio mixing, scrubbing
tests.ideas: - AC1: Manual verify Track 2 renders overlaid on Track 1 - AC2: Manual test all 4 PiP corners, verify positioning correct - AC3: Manual test playback synchronization of both tracks - AC4: Manual verify audio mixing at correct gain levels (Track 2 = 80%) - AC5: Manual test scrubbing updates preview correctly - AC6: Performance test verify 30fps with 1080p + 720p tracks - Unit test compositeFrame calculates PiP position correctly - Integration test verify currentTime sync to playhead - NFR validation: requestAnimationFrame loop < 16ms - Edge case: Track duration mismatch handled gracefully
